changed.title: Poisson thresholds for the number of largest extensions of mixed spaces after singular spacing-two mixing
changed.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → ∀ T D : ℕ → ℕ, Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
  (∀ k, 2 ≤ D k) → ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k => 6*(T k : ℝ)/
    (1+Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^(D k)-1))^(2*r+1)) Filter.atTop (nhds τ) →
  ∀ j : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ =>
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let t := T k
  let d := D k
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>
    if i.val % 2 = b.val / 2 ∧ (i.val / 2 % 3 = b.val % 2 ∨ i.val / 2 % 3 = 2)
    then (1:F) else 0
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin 4, (∑ i, h i b * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i)
  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)
  let spaces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter good
  let layer := spaces.filter (fun U : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F U = d)
  let mixed := layer.filter (fun U => ∀ b : Fin 2, ∃ i ∈ supp U, i.val % 2 = b.val)
  let move := fun (i : Fin n) (v : ℕ) =>
    (⟨(i.val+v) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let exits := fun S : Finset (Fin n) => S.filter (fun i => next i ∉ S)
  let gap := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) =>
    ((Finset.range n).filter (fun k => ∀ j : Fin (k+1), move i (j.val+1) ∉ S)).card
  let factor := fun g : ℕ => if (g-2) % 2 = 0 then (g-2)+1 else 1
  let hosts := fun U : Submodule F W => spaces.filter (fun E => U ≤ E)
  let topDim := fun U : Submodule F W => (hosts U).sup (fun E => Module.finrank F E)
  let countTop := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    ((hosts U).filter (fun E : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F E = topDim U)).card
  let small := fun S : Finset (Fin n) =>
    ∏ i ∈ exits S, if gap S i < 2*r+2 then factor (gap S i) else 1
  let event := mixed.filter (fun U => countTop U = small (supp U) * (2*r+1)^j)
  (event.card : ℝ)/(mixed.card : ℝ)) Filter.atTop
    (nhds (Real.exp (-(τ/2)) * (τ/2)^j / (Nat.factorial j : ℝ)))

changed.title: A polynomial-size Boolean circuit reconstructs a hidden graph from a short corrupted batch of fully pinned spin counts
changed.statement:
∃ C A : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ t k : ℕ, 2 ≤ t → 0 < k →
  let T := Fin t
  let V := Option (T × Bool)
  let Pair := {p : T × T // p.1 < p.2}
  let E := Fin 3 × T
  let Mask := T → Fin 3
  let tail := fun e : E => if e.1 = 0 then some (e.2,false) else (none : V)
  let head := fun e : E => some (e.2,decide (e.1 ≠ 1))
  let weight := fun (g : Option Pair) (e : E) (diff : Bool) =>
    if e.1 = 0 then diff.toNat else if e.1 = 2 then 1 else
    if g.elim false (fun p => decide (p.val.1 = e.2 ∨ p.val.2 = e.2)) then
      (if diff then 1 else 3) else (2 : ℕ)
  let obs := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    ∑ x : V → Bool, if (∀ i : T, p i = 0 ∨ p i = (if x (some (i,false)) then 2 else 1)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : E => x (tail e) ≠ x (head e))).card = 2*t then
      ∏ e : E, weight g e (xor (x (tail e)) (x (head e))) else 0
  let Pool := Finset Pair

  let read := fun (G : Pool) (pin : T → Bool) =>
    let p : Mask := fun i => if pin i then 2 else 1
    (obs none p)^(k-G.card) * ∏ e ∈ G, obs (some e) p
  let W := k*(t+2)+1
  ∃ (d : ℕ) (batch : Fin d → T → Bool) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (edge : Pair → Fin (2+d*W+g.size)),
    0 < d ∧ d ≤ C*k*(1+Nat.log 2 t) ∧ g.size ≤ (t+k+2)^A ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (2+d*W) g ∧
    (∀ gate ∈ g.gates, ((gate.op = .and ∨ gate.op = .or) ∧ gate.inputs.length = 2) ∨
      (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1)) ∧
    ∀ (G : Pool), G.card ≤ k →
      (∀ i, read G (batch i) < 2^W) ∧
      ∀ (y : Fin d → ℕ),
        400*(Finset.univ.filter (fun i => y i ≠ read G (batch i))).card ≤ d →
        let bits := (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin d => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin W =>
          (y i).testBit j.val))).flatten
        ∀ e : Pair, (g.wires ([false,true] ++ bits)).getD (edge e).val false = decide (e ∈ G)

changed.title: Perfect matchings count affine predictors one row below the saturated binary product budget
changed.statement:
∀ (n e : Nat), 0 < e →
  let m := 4*e-1
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin n → F
  let I := Fin m
  ∀ a b : I → W, (∀ i, a i ≠ 0 ∧ b i ≠ 0 ∧ a i ≠ b i) →
    let freq := fun i : I => ({a i, b i, a i+b i} : Finset W)
    let fs := (Finset.univ : Finset I).biUnion freq
    let odd := fs.filter (fun v => ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i => v ∈ freq i)).card % 2 = 1)
    let S := insert (0 : W) odd
    let outside := fun (i : I) => if h : ∃ v ∈ odd, v ∉ freq i then Classical.choose h else (0 : W)
    let good := (Finset.univ : Finset ((I → W) × (I → F))).filter (fun p =>
      ∀ x : W, ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i =>
        dotProduct (a i) x * dotProduct (b i) x ≠ dotProduct (p.1 i) x+p.2 i)).card ≤ e)
    let tally := fun (pivot : Option I) =>
      let nports := fun i : I => if pivot = some i then 4 else 3
      let label := fun (i : I) (j : Nat) =>
        if pivot = some i then outside i + (if j = 0 then 0 else if j = 1 then a i else if j = 2 then b i else a i+b i)
        else if j = 0 then a i else if j = 1 then b i else a i+b i
      let ports := (Finset.univ : Finset I).biUnion (fun i => (Finset.range (nports i)).image (fun j => (i,j)))
      let labels := ports.image (fun p => label p.1 p.2)
      let quota := fun v : W => (((ports.filter (fun p => label p.1 p.2 = v)).card) + (if pivot = none then 1 else 0)) / 2
      let V := (I × Nat) ⊕ (W × Nat)
      let localNodes := ports ∪ (Finset.univ : Finset I).image (fun i => (i,4))
      let slots := labels.biUnion (fun v => (Finset.range (quota v)).image (fun j => (v,j)))
      let verts : Finset V := localNodes.image Sum.inl ∪ slots.image Sum.inr
      let sameRow := fun (p q : I × Nat) => p.1 = q.1 ∧ p.2 ≠ q.2 ∧
        (p.2 = 4 ∨ q.2 = 4 ∨ p.2 / 2 = q.2 / 2)
      let attach := fun (p : I × Nat) (q : W × Nat) => p.2 < nports p.1 ∧ label p.1 p.2 = q.1
      let edge := fun (p q : V) => Sum.elim (fun x => Sum.elim (sameRow x) (attach x) q)
        (fun y => Sum.elim (fun x => attach x y) (fun _ => False) q) p
      let matchings := (Finset.univ : Finset (↥verts → ↥verts)).filter (fun f =>
        @decide (∀ x, f (f x) = x ∧ edge x.val (f x).val) (Classical.propDecidable _) = true)
      matchings.card / (∏ v ∈ labels, Nat.factorial (quota v))
    good.card = if 4 ≤ S.card ∧ (∀ v ∈ S, ∀ w ∈ S, v+w ∈ S) then
      S.card * tally none + (if S.card = 8 then ∑ i : I, if freq i ⊆ odd then tally (some i) else 0 else 0)
      else 0

changed.title: Randomized relative approximation of the total number of fitting optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions, with zero on every infeasible input
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)

let value := fun bs : List Bool => bs.foldr (fun b z => 2*z+b.toNat) 0
∃ (estimate : List Bool → List Bool) (randDegree : Nat), fast estimate ∧

∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  (∀ R ∈ pos, R.card ≤ 3) →
  (∀ i : Fin n, (pos.toFinset.filter (fun R => R.card = 3 ∧ i ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))
  let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let bank := fun R : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ R))
  let input := header n ++ header pos.length ++ pos.flatMap bank ++
    header neg.length ++ neg.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2)

  let total := Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f}
  ∀ (b a : Nat), 2 ≤ b → 1 ≤ a →
    let prefixBits := header b ++ header a ++ input
    let ell := (prefixBits.length+2)^randDegree
    let z := fun tape : Fin ell → Bool => value (estimate (prefixBits ++ List.ofFn tape))
    (total = 0 → ∀ tape, z tape = 0) ∧
    2^a * Nat.card {tape : Fin ell → Bool //
      (4*b-4)*total ≤ z tape ∧ z tape ≤ (4*b+4)*total} ≥ (2^a-1)*2^ell

changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit evaluates every weighted fiber of a binary affine relation at the cost of blocked matrix multiplication
changed.statement:
∀ (a b c m t : Nat),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin a → F
  let Y := Fin b → F
  let Z := Fin c → F
  let N := a+b+c
  let w := max a (max b c)
  let inputs := m*(N+1)+(2^a+2^b)*t
  let bitsOut := a+b+2*t+1
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (answer : Fin (2^c) → Fin bitsOut → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
    C.output = (answer 0 0).val ∧ C.size ≤ 2^60*(N+m+t+4)^30*2^(w % 2)*7^(w/2) ∧
    ∀ (H : Fin m → X × Y × Z) (rhs : Fin m → F)
      (f : Fin (2^a) → Fin (2^t)) (g : Fin (2^b) → Fin (2^t)),
      let pack := fun (s : Nat) (v : Fin s → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin s => decide (v j ≠ 0))
      let bits := (List.finRange m).flatMap (fun i =>
        pack a (H i).1 ++ pack b (H i).2.1 ++ pack c (H i).2.2 ++ [decide (rhs i ≠ 0)]) ++
        (List.finRange (2^a)).flatMap (fun ix => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin t => (f ix).val.testBit j.val)) ++
        (List.finRange (2^b)).flatMap (fun iy => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin t => (g iy).val.testBit j.val))
      let decode := fun (s v : Nat) (j : Fin s) => (if v.testBit j.val then 1 else 0 : F)
      let readWire := fun n : Fin (inputs+C.size) => (C.wires bits).getD n.val false
      let total := fun iz : Fin (2^c) =>
        ∑ ix : Fin (2^a), ∑ iy : Fin (2^b),
          if ∀ i, dotProduct (H i).1 (decode a ix.val) + dotProduct (H i).2.1 (decode b iy.val) +
            dotProduct (H i).2.2 (decode c iz.val) = rhs i then (f ix).val*(g iy).val else 0
      ∀ iz j, readWire (answer iz j) = (total iz).testBit j.val
